dedupe_keys.name: antares study dataset tyndp 2024 national trends 2040 onboarding model of the european power system

description: This Zenodo data set, published on 8 January 2026 by Thomas Heggarty and Arnauld Guillotin, is a ready-to-run study for the open-source Antares Simulator that loosely follows one scenario of the ENTSO-E Ten Year Network Development Plan 2024. Its stated purpose is onboarding: giving TSOs, industry, public bodies and academics a representative European example on which to learn the tool. Installed capacities follow the National Trends 2040 scenario. The description lists simplifications: parts of Eastern Europe are removed, and the hydrogen system is a single European node where electrolysis is the only production and stops above a power price threshold. The files are free to download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is most of the ENTSO-E area for one future year. Caveats: the authors state that outputs are not robust or suitable for policy recommendations, and the study is not the official TYNDP model. Simulation uses are adequacy, dispatch and cross-border flow simulation of a European power system and training in Antares before building one's own study. Related records: model-antares-simulator is the software it runs on, and data-entsos-tyndp-scenarios holds the official TYNDP scenario data.
